params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '===WORKER-FABRIC==='
Get-Content 'C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\fabric.json' -Raw
Write-Output '===MANAGER==='
Get-Content 'C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1' -Raw
Write-Output '===SERVICES==='
Get-Content 'C:\HeavenServices\services.json' -Raw
Write-Output '===OLLAMA==='
try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress } catch { $_.Exception.Message }
Write-Output '===AGENTCONTROL-ROOT==='
try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:7331/' -TimeoutSec 5 | Select-Object StatusCode,Content | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress } catch { $_.Exception.Message }
Write-Output '===SCRIPTS==='
Get-ChildItem 'C:\HeavenServices\scripts' -File | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Write-Output '===HOST==='
Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object @{n='FreeGB';e={[math]::Round($_.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2)}},@{n='TotalGB';e={[math]::Round($_.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2)}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
